## Where I stand
The HubSpot sync is done via 15-minute polling of the CRM search API (replacing webhooks), with windowed paging past the 10k search limit and a filter syncing only companies with ARR > 0. PR kestrel-analytics/platform#409 is still open with auto-merge enabled, blocked by one failing e2e check (the agent's claim that it merged was wrong); PR #405 was closed as superseded, and commits 8b3e6f1, 2d90ac4, ae47c15 sit on `daniel/hubspot-owner-sync`.

- [en-cours] PR #409 can't merge until `tests/e2e/test_admin_accounts.py::test_accounts_table_shows_owner` passes (expected 3 rows with owner, got 2; fixture fix not yet made)
- [prochaine-étape] fix that fixture (give the third company ARR > 0, or expect 2 rows), let checks go green so auto-merge fires
- [prochaine-étape] Noa to put `HUBSPOT_TOKEN` in AWS Secrets Manager for staging and prod (user will ask them)
- [essai-raté] registering the webhook subscription via API failed with 401: private app tokens can't manage webhook subscriptions, which forced the pivot to polling
- [décision] poll every 15 minutes instead of webhooks (source: t04)
- [décision] sync only companies with ARR > 0 and skip trials completely (source: t10)
